topic: How strict the outbound terms check is
detail: While the terms layer is on, SP-044 fails closed (outbound_unchecked) on any outbound command it cannot read in full: a variable or command substitution in it (except $HOME and $(cat <<'EOF' ...)), a command name built from a variable, loops, eval/xargs, git -c beyond a small allowlist, an earlier command that changes a remote or config, gh fed from a pipe. A gh write without -R counts every remote of the checkout (and GH_REPO) as a destination, so a fork whose upstream is another space's refuses the session's own terms in gh pr create. After git add/commit in the same call a push also checks the work tree, untracked files and every branch. Confirm this strictness, or say which cases should be allowed.
note: 2026-11-14: settled by D-60 (best-effort, loosened baseline in SP-044; configurable rules in SP-075).
